title: Grade 2 French — Mon, May 25
description: La famille — Day 1 of 5: Family member vocabulary
subject: french

questions.question: How do you say 'mother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Mère' = Mother. 'Ma mère s'appelle Priya.' = My mother's name is Priya.

questions.question: How do you say 'father' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Père' = Father. 'Mon père est grand.' = My father is tall.

questions.question: How do you say 'brother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Frère' = Brother. 'J'ai un frère.' = I have a brother.

questions.question: How do you say 'sister' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Sœur' = Sister. 'Ma sœur est petite.' = My sister is little.

questions.question: How do you say 'grandmother' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Grand-mère' = Grandmother. Literally 'big mother'. 'Ma grand-mère est gentille.' = My grandmother is kind.

questions.question: How do you say 'grandfather' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Grand-père' = Grandfather. Literally 'big father'. 'Mon grand-père est vieux.' = My grandfather is old.

questions.question: How do you say 'uncle' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Oncle' = Uncle. 'Mon oncle habite à Paris.' = My uncle lives in Paris.

questions.question: How do you say 'aunt' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Tante' = Aunt. 'Ma tante fait de bons gâteaux.' = My aunt makes good cakes.

questions.question: What does 'la famille' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La famille' = The family. 'J'aime ma famille.' = I love my family.

questions.question: How do you say 'son' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Fils' = Son. 'C'est mon fils.' = This is my son. The 's' at the end is silent!

questions.question: How do you say 'daughter' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Fille' = Daughter (also means 'girl'). 'Ma fille a 7 ans.' = My daughter is 7.

questions.question: How do you say 'cousin' (female) in French?
questions.explanation: 'Cousine' = Female cousin. 'Cousin' = Male cousin. They are different words in French!

questions.question: What is the French word for 'parents' (mother and father)?
questions.explanation: 'Les parents' = The parents (mother and father). 'Mes parents sont gentils.' = My parents are kind.

questions.question: What does 'les enfants' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Les enfants' = The children. 'Il y a trois enfants dans ma famille.' = There are three children in my family.

questions.question: Match: Père / Mère / Frère / Sœur = ?
questions.explanation: Père=Father, Mère=Mother, Frère=Brother, Sœur=Sister — the four core family words.
